authorization.statement: OK, let's lock in header Project → file-owned Project → blank. Next, how do Media Composer and MDVX read Kind from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep? How does that compare with the current MediaMuster implementation?
authorization.scope: Approves the simplified Project rule and its previously presented text/availability/retention details. The request to review Kind does not approve new Kind rules or other MXF field/navigation proposals.

sourceOrderWithinMxf: Usable Project attributes on the qualified physical file SourcePackage
Unavailable; blank on database-unavailable MXF fallback if neither is usable
agreedBellaRules.fileOwnedKeys: Within the qualified file owner, use exact _PJ, then exact PROJNAME, then _PJ within an explicitly recorded supported _USER list. Follow only those known paths. Do not use key prefixes, arbitrary strings, UserComments, generic recursive flattening, master/source Project recovery or a synthesized DMS1 Project attribute.
agreedBellaRules.unicode: Decode header ProjectName and attribute names as their known UTF-16BE types. Supported Avid/AAF indirect String values identify their type and B/L byte order before UTF-16BE/LE text. Reuse the planned bounded UTF-16 helper with checked code units/surrogates, QtEndian and one owned QString. Stop at a bounded zero terminator when present; otherwise complete valid text may end at its declared boundary. No guessed UTF-8/MacRoman, numeric coercion or lossy replacement.
agreedBellaRules.availabilityAndConflicts: Missing, empty, whitespace-only or individually unreadable candidates can advance while framing and ownership remain trustworthy. Preserve spelling, case, Unicode and all spacing in a nonblank value. Conflicting usable duplicates at the same priority leave Project unavailable rather than hiding the conflict behind a lower key/source. No usable header/file-owned value leaves MXF Project unavailable and blank on database-unavailable fallback, retaining the physical row and independent facts. Never infer Project from a path, filename or open application.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Stop after a usable preferred value. Retain only the selected Unicode text and necessary compact availability/source context. Release temporary bytes, tag/package indexes and unused alternatives. No routine lower-candidate comparison, permanent Project ancestry graph or extra media open.
